name: editorial_architecture_fractional_grid_v1
notes: Bounded/fractional grid: the full Cartesian product would be wasteful.
Every configuration still uses at least one verified Narrative Memory item; placement changes.
All configurations use the same three folds, target length and blinded evaluator.

configurations.label: Current-like forced memory opening
configurations.hypothesis: Reference arm approximating the forced-opening contract.

configurations.label: Fit-gated memory + concrete scene
configurations.hypothesis: A relevance gate plus a concrete scene should preserve Narrative Memory without forcing a weak opening.

configurations.label: Fit-gated memory + human tension
configurations.hypothesis: Four larger beats and immediate human tension should improve voice and narrative motion.

configurations.label: Evidence first, memory second
configurations.hypothesis: Let current evidence establish stakes before the historical analogy.

configurations.label: Memory as narrative turn
configurations.hypothesis: History may work better as a midpoint reframing device than as an opening obligation.

configurations.label: Memory reserved for payoff
configurations.hypothesis: A late callback can satisfy the memory requirement while keeping the opening contemporary.

configurations.label: Forced opening but aggressively short
configurations.hypothesis: The problem may be duration rather than placement.

configurations.label: Forced memory scene + very fast evidence
configurations.hypothesis: A vivid compressed memory scene followed immediately by evidence may recover attention.

configurations.label: Fit gate with denser evidence
configurations.hypothesis: More evidence and six beats may help editorial rigor even if voice becomes more structured.

configurations.label: Minimal evidence, four beats
configurations.hypothesis: One or two strong cases may outperform broad coverage by reducing dossier-like prose.

configurations.label: Evidence-first with broader evidence
configurations.hypothesis: Moving memory later may preserve voice even with three or four current cases.

configurations.label: Scene opening, history as turn, four beats
configurations.hypothesis: A current scene plus a mid-essay historical turn may maximize narrative motion.

configurations.label: Scene opening with late memory callback
configurations.hypothesis: Memory may work best as payoff after the audience understands the current mechanism.

configurations.label: Fit gate + spoken cadence
configurations.hypothesis: Breathable spoken syntax may directly address Voice without changing evidence breadth.

configurations.label: Fit gate + strongest discovery mode
configurations.hypothesis: Four-beat investigation with explicit uncertainty should feel more like live thinking.

configurations.label: Fit gate without required counterargument
configurations.hypothesis: Tests whether the counterargument requirement adds depth or merely another checklist section.

configurations.label: Fit gate + three to four evidence cases
configurations.hypothesis: Isolates evidence breadth while keeping the preferred architecture.

configurations.label: Fit gate + early thesis
configurations.hypothesis: Tests whether early thesis improves clarity at the cost of mystery and retention.

configurations.label: Paradox opening, evidence, then memory
configurations.hypothesis: A paradox can create mystery while current evidence earns the historical analogy.

configurations.label: Minimal evidence + memory as turn
configurations.hypothesis: Combines narrow evidence with mid-essay historical reframing to test depth over breadth.
